description: The deposit supplies synthetic pressure-transient responses, reservoir and fluid parameters, and target properties for physics-guided machine learning. It includes material for training, testing, noise assessment and out-of-distribution evaluation. The provider is Oritom Hezekiah-Braye; Godloves T. Nonju. Coverage: The parameter ranges are described as representative of Niger Delta sandstones. They are synthetic scenarios, without a stated observed field period or sampled-well inventory. The public deposit provides a free access route; downstream software and third-party data may have separate conditions. Limitations: Representativeness, noise realism and reported prediction quality are provider claims. The files and benchmark splits were not inspected. For simulation it supports surrogate-model experiments and reservoir-characterisation benchmarks.
